note: Official JNF / Green Horizons bank. Three families: settlements, jnf-sites, general-sites. Coordinates are WGS84. English only.

questions.name: Ofakim
questions.hint: A Negev development town west of Be'er Sheva, in a JNF focus area of the western Negev.

questions.name: Sderot
questions.hint: A western Negev town overlooking the Gaza envelope, long a JNF focus community.

questions.name: Netivot
questions.hint: A Negev town between Ofakim and Sderot, in the northwestern Negev.

questions.name: Yeruham
questions.hint: A small Negev town south of Dimona, beside a desert lake and crater country.

questions.name: Mitzpe Ramon
questions.hint: A cliff-top Negev town on the rim of the Ramon Crater.

questions.name: Arad
questions.hint: A desert town on the edge of the Judean Desert, east of Be'er Sheva toward the Dead Sea.

questions.name: Be'er Sheva
questions.hint: Capital of the Negev and a major JNF urban focus in Israel's south.

questions.name: Ramat Negev Regional Council
questions.hint: A vast rural council in the central Negev, covering farms and desert communities south of Be'er Sheva.

questions.name: Eshkol Regional Council
questions.hint: A western Negev regional council of kibbutzim and moshavim along the Gaza envelope.

questions.name: Shlomit
questions.hint: A young community in the Halutza sands of the western Negev, near the Egyptian border.

questions.name: Bnei Netzarim
questions.hint: A Halutza sands community in the western Negev, south of the Gaza envelope.

questions.name: Kibbutz Be'eri
questions.hint: A Gaza-envelope kibbutz in the northwestern Negev, a JNF focus community.

questions.name: Sha'ar HaNegev Regional Council
questions.hint: A cluster of kibbutzim and communities north of the Gaza envelope, around Sderot.

questions.name: Kibbutz Kfar Aza
questions.hint: A Gaza-envelope kibbutz just east of the border, in the Sha'ar HaNegev region.

questions.name: Kibbutz Nir Oz
questions.hint: A western Negev kibbutz in the Eshkol region, near the Gaza envelope.

questions.name: Kibbutz Re'im
questions.hint: A Gaza-envelope kibbutz in the northwestern Negev, near the Nova festival site.

questions.name: Sapir (Central Arava)
questions.hint: An Arava community that serves as a hub for the central Arava, north of Eilat.

questions.name: Eilot Regional Council
questions.hint: The southernmost regional council in Israel, covering Arava communities north of Eilat.

questions.name: Central Arava Regional Council
questions.hint: A long strip of Arava farming communities between the Dead Sea and Eilat.

questions.name: Kiryat Shmona
questions.hint: The main town of the Hula Valley, at the foot of the Naftali Mountains in the far north.

questions.name: Beit She'an
questions.hint: An ancient and modern town in the Jordan Valley, famous for Roman ruins and a JNF focus area.

questions.name: Galil Elyon Regional Council
questions.hint: Upper Galilee kibbutzim and moshavim around the Hula Valley and Naftali hills.

questions.name: Kibbutz Misgav Am
questions.hint: A hilltop kibbutz on the Naftali ridge, overlooking Lebanon in the Upper Galilee.

questions.name: JNF-USA Culinary Center
questions.hint: A JNF-USA culinary and community center at Kibbutz Gonen in the Hula Valley.

questions.name: JNF-USA Zionist Village
questions.hint: A JNF-USA site in Be'er Sheva River Park, part of the city's green river revitalization.

questions.name: JNF Arava Campus
questions.hint: A JNF campus at Kibbutz Sapir serving education and community life in the central Arava.

questions.name: JNF Business Complex
questions.hint: A JNF business and employment complex in Mitzpe Ramon on the Ramon Crater rim.

questions.name: Alexander Muss Campus
questions.hint: The Alexander Muss High School in Israel campus in Hod HaSharon, a JNF-USA education site.

questions.name: Lotem Emek HaShalom
questions.hint: A JNF-linked site in Emek HaShalom by Nahal HaShofet Park, in the Menashe Hills.

questions.name: Neot Kedumim
questions.hint: A biblical landscape reserve between Tel Aviv and Jerusalem, planting the plants of ancient Israel.

questions.name: Old City of Acre (Akko)
questions.hint: A UNESCO-listed Crusader and Ottoman port city on the northern Mediterranean coast.

questions.name: Kfar Saba
questions.hint: A central Sharon-plain city just east of Herzliya and Ra'anana.

questions.name: Ariel Sharon Park
questions.hint: A huge metropolitan park on the former Hiriya landfill, at the eastern edge of Tel Aviv.

questions.name: ANU Museum, Tel Aviv
questions.hint: The Museum of the Jewish People on the Tel Aviv University campus in Ramat Aviv.

questions.name: Ayalon Institute, Rehovot
questions.hint: A secret pre-state underground bullet factory hidden beneath a kibbutz hill in Rehovot.

questions.name: Weizmann Institute, Rehovot
questions.hint: Israel's renowned science research institute in Rehovot, named for the first president.

questions.name: Technion, Haifa
questions.hint: Israel's leading technology university, set on the slopes of Mount Carmel in Haifa.

questions.name: Baha'i Gardens, Haifa
questions.hint: Terraced gardens cascading down Mount Carmel, a UNESCO site in Haifa.

questions.name: Caesarea
questions.hint: A Roman port city on the Mediterranean, with a theater, aqueduct, and Crusader walls.

questions.name: The Western Wall
questions.hint: Judaism's holiest prayer site, a remnant of the Temple Mount in Jerusalem's Old City.

questions.name: Elah Valley
questions.hint: The lowland valley where David is said to have faced Goliath, southwest of Jerusalem.

questions.name: Yad Vashem
questions.hint: Israel's Holocaust memorial and museum on the Mount of Remembrance in Jerusalem.

questions.name: Ammunition Hill
questions.hint: A Six-Day War battleground and memorial in northern Jerusalem.

questions.name: Mount Tabor
questions.hint: A distinct dome-shaped mountain in the Lower Galilee, site of the Transfiguration.

questions.name: Nimrod Fortress
questions.hint: A huge medieval fortress on the southern slopes of Mount Hermon, overlooking the Golan.

questions.name: Banias Nature Reserve
questions.hint: Hermon Stream springs, waterfalls, and ancient ruins at the foot of Mount Hermon.

questions.name: Gamla
questions.hint: A clifftop ancient city and nature reserve on the Golan, known as the Masada of the north.

questions.name: Mount Bental
questions.hint: A lookout volcano on the northern Golan with views into Syria and toward Mount Hermon.

questions.name: Mount Hermon
questions.hint: Israel's highest peak — and its only ski resort in winter.

questions.name: Rosh HaNikra
questions.hint: Chalk sea grottoes on the Lebanese border, reached by cable car along the coast.

questions.name: Yehi'am Fortress
questions.hint: A Crusader and later fortress in the Western Galilee, inside a national park by Kibbutz Yehi'am.

questions.name: Montfort Castle
questions.hint: A ruined Teutonic Crusader castle hidden in a Western Galilee river gorge.

questions.name: Yardenit Baptismal Site
questions.hint: A baptism site on the Jordan River just south of the Sea of Galilee.

questions.name: Mount Gilboa
questions.hint: A mountain ridge above the Harod and Beit She'an valleys, famous for spring irises.

questions.name: Tel Megiddo
questions.hint: The ancient hill of Armageddon, a UNESCO tel guarding the Jezreel Valley.

questions.name: Tzippori / Sepphoris
questions.hint: A mosaic-rich Galilee archaeological park, once a Roman-era Jewish city near Nazareth.

questions.name: Mount Arbel
questions.hint: A cliff above the Sea of Galilee with a fortress cave and a famous hiking overlook.

questions.name: Hula Nature Reserve
questions.hint: A restored wetland in the Hula Valley, a major bird-migration stop in the north.

questions.name: Tomb of the Rambam
questions.hint: The burial place of Maimonides in Tiberias, on the western shore of the Sea of Galilee.

questions.name: Apollonia (Herzliya)
questions.hint: Crusader cliff ruins on the Mediterranean shore at the northern edge of Herzliya.

questions.name: Tel Afek (Antipatris Fortress)
questions.hint: An ancient tel and Ottoman fortress at the Yarkon springs, east of Petah Tikva.

questions.name: Beit She'arim National Park
questions.hint: Catacombs of a Jewish necropolis in the Lower Galilee, a UNESCO World Heritage site.

questions.name: Ramat Hanadiv
questions.hint: Memorial gardens and a nature park on the southern Carmel, above Zichron Ya'akov.

questions.name: The Castel
questions.hint: A hilltop fortress and 1948 battleground on the road up to Jerusalem from the coast.

questions.name: Sorek Stalactite Cave
questions.hint: A spectacular stalactite cave in the Judean Hills, southwest of Jerusalem.

questions.name: Tel Gezer
questions.hint: A biblical tel in the Shephelah guarding the road from the coast up to Jerusalem.

questions.name: Tel Lachish
questions.hint: A major biblical fortress tel in the Judean Shephelah, south of Beit Guvrin.

questions.name: Masada
questions.hint: A clifftop desert fortress overlooking the Dead Sea, reached by snake path or cable car.

questions.name: Ein Gedi Nature Reserve
questions.hint: Desert waterfalls and ibex country on the western shore of the Dead Sea.

questions.name: Ein Bokek
questions.hint: The main hotel strip on the southern Dead Sea, famous for spa beaches.

questions.name: Tel Arad
questions.hint: Canaanite and Israelite ruins on a desert tel east of modern Arad.

questions.name: Ben-Gurion's Tomb
questions.hint: The graves of David and Paula Ben-Gurion overlooking Zin Canyon at Midreshet Ben-Gurion.

questions.name: Ein Avdat National Park
questions.hint: A deep desert canyon with a spring and ibex, along the Zin in the Negev Highlands.

questions.name: Timna Park
questions.hint: Ancient copper mines, red sandstone, and mushroom rocks north of Eilat.

questions.name: Yad Mordechai
questions.hint: A Gaza-envelope kibbutz with a 1948 battlefield museum and a statue of Mordechai Anielewicz.

questions.name: Re'im Nova Memorial Site
questions.hint: The memorial at the Nova music festival site near Kibbutz Re'im in the western Negev.

questions.name: Shivta National Park
questions.hint: A ruined Byzantine desert city on the Incense Route in the Negev.

questions.name: Eshkol Park (Ein HaBesor)
questions.hint: A green oasis and springs in the Besor, in the western Negev Eshkol region.

questions.name: The Red Canyon
questions.hint: A narrow red-sandstone slot canyon in the southern Eilat Mountains.

questions.name: Hai-Bar Yotvata Nature Reserve
questions.hint: A desert wildlife reserve in the southern Arava that reintroduces biblical animals.

questions.name: Tel Be'er Sheva
questions.hint: The ancient tel of biblical Beersheba, a UNESCO site just east of the modern city.

questions.name: Muhraka Monastery
questions.hint: A Carmelite monastery on Mount Carmel marking Elijah's contest with the prophets of Baal.

questions.name: Tel Dor
questions.hint: An ancient coastal tel and lagoon south of Haifa, once a major Phoenician and royal port.

questions.name: Pool of the Arches, Ramla
questions.hint: An underground Abbasid cistern with stone arches in the city of Ramla.

questions.name: Yad La-Shiryon, Latrun
questions.hint: Israel's armored corps memorial and tank museum at Latrun, on the road to Jerusalem.
